style: who is speaking to whom, and what has just happened

candidates.evidence: समत्वं योग उच्यते (equanimity is called yoga)

candidates.angle: Krishna defines yoga as being equal in success and failure
candidates.evidence: सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योः समो भूत्वा (having become equal in success and failure)

candidates.angle: Dhananjaya, the conqueror of wealth, is told to act

en.intro: Krishna has told Arjuna to act, but not to crave the results. Now he gives the precise inner state that makes that action true yoga. Listen to how he defines it.
en.notice: Krishna does not define yoga as a posture or a breath. He defines it as samatvam, evenness. The exact moment of success or failure does not have to shake the one who is established in yoga.
en.next: Krishna now contrasts that steady state with action born of craving, and calls the craving-driven path pitiful. Listen.
en.next_hi: कृष्ण अब उस स्थिर मन की तुलना लालच से भरे कर्म से करते हैं, और उसे दयनीय बताते हैं।
en.meaning: O Dhananjaya, perform actions while established in yoga, abandoning attachment. Remain equal in success and failure, for equanimity is called yoga.

hi.intro: कृष्ण ने अर्जुन से कहा है कि कर्म करो पर फल की लालसा न रखो। अब वे उस भीतरी अवस्था को बताते हैं जो उस कर्म को सच्चा योग बनाती है।
hi.meaning: हे धनंजय, आसक्ति छोड़कर, काम पूरा हो या न हो, दोनों में समान भाव रखते हुए योग में स्थित होकर कर्म करो। यही समता योग कहलाती है।
hi.notice: आसक्ति छोड़, सफलता-असफलता में सम रहकर कर्म करो; समता ही योग है
